title: Over 200 protesters detained for more than 24 hours; solon calls for probe
summary: More than 200 protesters from Southern Tagalog, who were arrested on Sunday during the opening day of the ASEAN Summit, remained in detention for over 24 hours at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City.
